headline: Riolo-Cohen-Axelrod 2001 tag-cooperation (agent-based): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; donation rate=0.613 (band [0.55,0.85]), cluster share=0.910, CV=0.323, crash-recover 10/10 seeds

verdicts.gate: P1 tag-similarity sustains cooperation (no reciprocity): mean donation rate in [0.55, 0.85] at P=3
P2 dominant tag cluster forms: time-averaged modal-tag-cluster share >= 0.6 (|tau-modal|<=0.01)
P3 cooperation is intermittent (waves of tolerance): CV(donation rate) >= 0.1 AND crash-and-recover in a majority of seeds

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce tag-based cooperation without reciprocity, its dominant-cluster formation, and its intermittent tolerance waves — and would catch an artifact

citations: Riolo, R.L., Cohen, M.D. & Axelrod, R. (2001). Evolution of cooperation without reciprocity. Nature 414:441-443. doi:10.1038/35106555.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the donation rate, dominant-tag cluster share, and intermittent-wave (CV + crash-and-recover) signatures
